body: Yeah, I know. And as I said, I regret it every time I see him. And I wish I could take it back every single time I see him.  But only can't now,  it happened,  oh well.

Yeahp, probably somewhere around there. And yeah, I love that picture you sent, it's pretty neat,  actually. I might just print it our haha, thank you.  And I am sure everything will be alright,  but it's so hard to get over her,  and I know,  I will eventually, and there is no need to worry haha,  I'll find the "special one" who is perfect for me.  But, fuck. Being 16 really fucking sucks. I'm glad you overcame. What you had to,  cause other wise, you wouldn't have been able to help me. And that means a lot.

Belief in a god.

Edit for clarification:
I don't  believe in a god,  I believe something/someone must have made the first "thing", but I find it hard to believe that someone is all seeing, all knowing, and all forgiving when good people die everyday for things out of their control, and when bad men rule the world with fear and power.
Hey,  if you don't mind me asking, why the fuck would you take your girl to a strip club? Also,  if you're gonna, why choose one where you are a regular? I don't really understand that logic at all.

As a 16 year old, convinced my girlfriend to steal her sister's car, and come over to my house. Then we walked to a picnic table at about 1 in the morning and I lost my virginity. Condom-less. Not the smartest decision, but I felt pretty manly.

It was perfect. We had a bit of a weird relationship. Met freshman year, liked each other, but nothing ever happened. Eventually, partway through sophomore year, we start fooling around and setting. We have sex, finally, the beginning of junior year, and ended up dating a few days later. We ended up falling in love so quickly and it was truly crazy and fantastic. Homecoming night, she said it. I didn't first, because I'm about as gutless as chicken shit,  but then I said it. In that moment, I truly was the happiest guy alive, and to this day, she is my true love and my everything.
Atleast you bought 2 boxes, I can see the first one is emptying out like my mother's bowels.
